cards.back:

Bahasa Indonesia: memberanikan diri menghadapi hal sulit

cards.say: bite the bullet. To do something hard that you have been avoiding. I had to bite the bullet and speak in front of the class.

cards.say: see eye to eye. To agree with someone. My sister and I see eye to eye on most things.

cards.say: face the music. To accept the result of something you did. He had to face the music after breaking the window.

cards.back:

cards.front: The pen is mightier than the sword

cards.say: The pen is mightier than the sword. It means words can have more power than fighting.
